declarations.name: VegaChart
declarations.summary: A responsive Vega or Vega-Lite visualization driven by a declarative specification.

attributes.name: spec
attributes.description: A Vega or Vega-Lite specification object, or a URL accepted by Vega-Embed.

attributes.name: data
attributes.description: Rows keyed by Vega dataset name. Updates use the current Vega view without re-embedding the specification.

attributes.name: signals
attributes.description: Values keyed by Vega signal name. Updates use the current Vega view without re-embedding the specification.

attributes.name: signal_listeners
attributes.description: Vega signal names re-dispatched through vega-signal events.

attributes.name: actions
attributes.description: Whether Vega-Embed shows its action menu.

events.name: vega-ready
events.description: Dispatched after the specification has rendered.

events.name: vega-update
events.description: Dispatched after named datasets or input signals have updated.

events.name: vega-signal
events.description: A watched Vega signal changed; detail contains its name and value.

events.name: vega-error
events.description: Dispatched when Vega-Embed cannot render the specification.
